name: Question 6
problem: Consider a spherical planet with radius $(2\times {10}^{7})\,\text{m}$ and surface gravitational acceleration $g=20\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}.$ Which equation best models the velocity $v$ of an object projected radially outward from the planet's surface with an initial velocity of $(6\times {10}^{4})\,\text{m/s},$ where $r$ is the distance from the planet's center to the object. Assume the only force acting on the object is the force due to gravity.

html:
Question 6
?

Consider a spherical planet with radius (2×107)m and surface gravitational acceleration g=20m/s2. Which equation best models the velocity v of an object projected radially outward from the planet's surface with an initial velocity of (6×104)m/s, where r is the distance from the planet's center to the object. Assume the only force acting on the object is the force due to gravity.

a
v2=1.6×1016r−(2.8×109)
b
v2=1.6×1016r+(2.8×109)
c
v2=0.8×1016r−(3.6×109)
d
v2=0.8×1016r+(2.8×109)
e
v2=1.6×1016r2+(3.6×109)
Submit
